## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Trenton, United States. It starts at 321 Chestnut Street.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Conveniently located in the heart of Philadelphia's Old City, the National Liberty Museum brings the idea of liberty to life with the stories of people, past and present, whose courageous actions inspire us to defend and advance freedom for all. Take a walk in the shoes of the selfless people who have helped to shape the free world through acts of defiance, bravery, and sacrifice, and regain a deeper appreciation for the liberty you enjoy.
>
> With a combination of special temporary exhibitions that highlight specific stories and people, as well as a cutting-edge permanent exhibition, the National Liberty Museum is an absolute must for anyone who truly values the real meaning and substance of freedom.
